title: ChemCrow: a language-model agent with chemistry tools
summary: An agent with 18 tools and GPT-4 planned and carried out the synthesis of DEET and three thiourea organocatalysts on a cloud platform, and guided discovery of a chromophore absorbing at 336 nm against a 369 nm target; evaluated on 14 cases by four expert chemists. Hallucinations, limited tasks and dual-use risks; 12 of 18 tools were released.

evidence.tested: Expert and LLM judgments were used to evaluate the agent, which planned and executed syntheses of an insect repellent and three organocatalysts and guided discovery of a chromophore.
evidence.unknown: The abstract says LLMs struggle with chemistry and lack external knowledge, and GPT-4 as evaluator could not distinguish clearly wrong completions from ChemCrow's performance.
evidence.ai_role: An LLM agent with 18 expert-designed chemistry tools planned and executed syntheses and guided molecular discovery; the page does not name the underlying model.
